notes.title: 🎣 Patch Notes v0.5b – Fishing Improvements
notes.content:
[p]Hello Bazaar Folks!
Following the major v0.5a update, we’ve rolled out a small patch to fix a few bugs and improve your fishing experience based on your feedback. Here’s what’s new in v0.5b:[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🐟 Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h2][list][*][p][b]XP gain for Pike (turna) was incorrect[/b] – this has been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]A bug preventing the Large Fish Bucket from being sent to the market area[/b] has been resolved.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Customers no longer push or block the player.[/b] Based on popular demand, physical collisions with customers have been removed. You can now move freely through crowds.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fish type wasn't visible at the fish stall UI.[/b] A new visual indicator now shows the name of the fish when you hover over it.[/p][/*][*][p][b]A new tutorial sequence has been added[/b] for fishing. When you first get the fish stall, a short guide now explains how to sell fish.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]🎯 Small but meaningful tweaks to make your fishing experience smoother and clearer.
Thanks for your continued support! More content is on the way… 🐠🧺[/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.5a – Vendor and Fisheries Update
notes.content: [h1]🧺🎣Hello Bazaar Vendors! [/h1][p][/p][h3]📢 [b]A Quick Developer Update[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We know we’ve been quiet for a while. The main reason for this delay was some complex technical challenges we faced with the multiplayer system. As the game’s sole developer, solving these issues and thoroughly testing everything takes considerable time.[/p][p][/p][p]But now, an important decision has been made: We’ll be rolling out smaller, more frequent updates to tackle bugs incrementally. This will make development more sustainable while keeping our communication with you stronger than ever.[/p][p][/p][p]Here’s what’s new in this update:[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]🆕 New Features[/h2][p][/p][h3]🎣 [b]Fishing System[/b][/h3][list][*][p]New Fishing Area: A scenic, expansive fishing zone has been added to the map, worth exploring![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051738/afc4bb9b10a192b01ad50b58f4b36938b9eb8790.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Fish Cleaning Mechanic: Some fish can now be cleaned and prepared for sale after catching.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051738/bc289f0fec76461945a7384536c5308b1328834a.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Fish Stall: A dedicated stall just for selling fish is now available in the market.[/p][/*][*][p]Multi-Fish Sales: Display and sell different types of fish simultaneously.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]👷 [b]Worker System[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Carrier Workers: Automatically collect and place products on your stall.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051738/545a5699b53392d25c8203e06a800164655792be.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Cashier Workers: Interact with customers and make sales, saving you time and boosting profits.[/p][/*][*][p]Worker performance varies by task, and each must be paid for their services.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🖥️ UI Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Menu and inventory designs have been refreshed for better readability and usability.[/p][/*][*][p]Visual upgrades to the sales screen and product management sections.[/p][/*][*][p]Tooltips and interaction icons are now more intuitive.[/p][/*][/list][h2]💡 Graphics & Lighting Enhancements[/h2][list][*][p]Global Lighting Update: More natural and warm lighting across the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Realistic Sunrise/Sunset Transitions: Smoother and more visually striking.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Day/Night Cycle: Increased contrast for better visibility at night.[/p][/*][/list][h2]🌐 New Language Support[/h2][p]The game now speaks your language! Five new languages have been added:[/p][list][*][p]🇭🇺 Hungarian [/p][/*][*][p]🇷🇴 Romanian [/p][/*][*][p]🇷🇸 Serbian[/p][/*][*][p]🇨🇿 Czech[/p][/*][*][p]🇵🇹 Portuguese [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]You can change the language easily in the settings menu.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🛠️ Bug Fixes[/h2][p][/p][h3]🌐 [b]Multiplayer Access & Stability[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed issues preventing players from joining sessions or connecting to the server.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved synchronization and progress tracking in multiplayer mode.[/p][/*][/list][p]➡️ We’re aware that some multiplayer issues still exist, and we’ll continue resolving them in upcoming patches.[/p][p][/p][h3]📥 Download the Update Now![/h3][p]Grab your fishing rod, manage your workers, and expand your stall! This update brings a more dynamic, visually satisfying, and rich market experience.[/p][h2][/h2][h2]🔮 Next Major Update: Your Own SHOP![/h2][p]Yes, the next big content drop will let you open your own shop! Stay tuned for details soon.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051738/a821c5284d4ac04c36b38dfbb7dc4f2df70a7fad.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]🎁 Thank You for Your Support![/p][p]Happy selling, and may your profits soar![/p][p]– Mithra Interactive[/p]

notes.title: Patch v0.2.0
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, Bazaar Vendors! ✨ Patch v0.2.0 is here![/h3]

🛠 [b]Multiplayer Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]  Product Crate Pickup Delay – Fixed an issue where picking up product crates was delayed, especially in multiplayer sessions. 
[*]  Shop Loading Delay – Resolved a bug that caused the shop to open slowly in multiplayer mode. 
[*]  Training Panel Delay – Fixed an issue where training panels took longer than expected to open for multiple players. 
[*]  Scale Bowl Placement – Addressed a bug causing delays when picking up and placing the scale bowl in multiplayer. 
[*]  Apron & Cart Glitch – Clicking on the apron or cart no longer causes bug and unintended movement for other players. 
[*]  Stuck Plastic Bag – Fixed a bug where plastic bags would sometimes remain stuck in hand during multiplayer sessions. 
[/list]

🛠[b] General Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]  Scale Weight Calibration – Resolved an issue where pressing weights repeatedly would disrupt the scale’s accuracy. 
[*]  Stuck Scale Issue – Fixed a bug where the scale could sometimes get stuck in hand. 
[*]  Selling Placeable Items – Fixed an issue where selling certain placeable tools would cause errors.
[/list]
📥 Update now and enjoy a smoother multiplayer marketplace experience! 

Happy selling!

notes.title: Patch Note v0.1.2a
notes.content:

notes.title: Customers Can Order Multiple Products! Check Patch Notes v0.1.2
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, Bazaar Vendors! ✨ Patch v0.1.2 is here!
[/h3]
[b]We've been hard at work fixing bugs and improving gameplay. Here’s what’s new:[/b]

[h2]🆕 New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Multiple Orders for Customers – Customers can now place more than one order at a time! 🛍️
[*] Revamped Music – Added background music to the main menu and refreshed in-game music for a more immersive experience. 🎶
[/list]
[h2]🛠 Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Customer Collisions – Adjusted customer colliders to prevent unwanted interactions with products. 🚶‍♂️⚡
[*] Single Sales Stall Collision – Fixed an issue where moving the single sales stall caused it to collide with other products. 🔧
[*] Bag-to-Bowl Glitch – Resolved an issue where placing bagged products into bowls would cause the cash register to reappear in hand. 💰➡️🥣
[*]Save System Fix – Players can now successfully save the products inside trolley vehicles. 💾 
[*] Floating Items Bug – Fixed a glitch where some products remained stuck in the player's hand. 🖐️❌
[*] XP Calculation Fix – Corrected an issue where XP values were incorrectly assigned when paying with a phone. 📱📈
[/list]
[h2]⚖ Balancing & Improvements[/h2]
[olist]
[*]Cabbage Highlight on Spawn – Cabbages now spawn without a highlight.🥬✨
[*] Item Stall Alignment – Resolved an issue where single product stalls didn’t align properly when placed side by side. 🏗️
[*] Market Discounts Balanced – Adjusted the discount rates in the wholesale market for fairer pricing. 🏷️📉
[*] Mouse Sensitivity Fix – Sensitivity settings now save correctly between sessions. 🖱️🎯
[*] Apron Positioning – Increased the apron’s distance on the single item stall to improve visibility. ✔️
[/olist]
📥 Download the update now and enjoy an improved marketplace experience! 🚀

Happy selling! 🏪💰

notes.content:

notes.title: Patch v.0.1.0
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, Bazaar Vendors! 🎉[/h2]

[h2]🛠 Bug Fixes[/h2]
[b]4th Player Going Off the Map:[/b] Fixed an issue where the 4th player would go off the map when joining the game. 🗺
[b]
Cabbage Sales Quantity Issue:[/b] Resolved the problem with incorrect quantities during cabbage sales.

[b]Scale Weight Issues: [/b]Fixed a bug where customers refused to accept products even when the scale weight was correct. ⚖

[b]Incorrect Product Acceptance:[/b] Addressed an issue where customers accepted the wrong item when given a different product.

[b]Camera Reset After Phone Payment:[/b] Fixed the problem where the camera didn’t return to its original position after making a phone payment. 📱

[b]Pumpkin Sales Issue:[/b] Resolved the problem affecting pumpkin sales. 🎃

[b]Ground Collider Issue:[/b] Fixed small collider issues on the ground.

[b]Price Tag Overflow:[/b] Corrected the overflow issue on price tags for large numbers. 💰

[b]Localization Text Overflow:[/b] Adjusted word overflow in the marketplace localization. 🌍

[b]Produce Visibility Issues:[/b] Resolved an issue where cucumbers and other produce weren’t displaying correctly. 🥒

[b]Red Bell Peppers Displaying as Tomatoes:[/b] Fixed a bug where red bell peppers appeared as tomatoes in the market. 🫑➡🍅
[b]
Customer Requests Exceeding Capacity:[/b] Fixed a bug where customers requested more products than the bowl or bag could hold. 🛍

[h2]🚀 New Features[/h2]
[b]Area Expansion Mechanic:[/b] Unlock new areas to grow your bazaar empire! 🌟

[b]Single-Player Mode Pause:[/b] The game now stops in single-player mode when paused. ⏸

[b]Record Deletion:[/b] Added the ability to delete records for a cleaner save file. 🗑


[h2]🌍 Localization Improvements[/h2]
Fixed untranslated texts and improved overall translation accuracy. We’ll continue to monitor and refine translations in future updates. 🌐
[h2]
💬 Your Feedback Matters![/h2]
We’re incredibly grateful for your support and enthusiasm for Bazaar Simulator! Your feedback drives us to make the game better every day. If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, please let us know.

[b]Update now and dive back into the vibrant world of trading! Happy selling, and thank you for being part of our community! 🎮✨[/b]

notes.title: Bazaar Simulator Devlogs #1
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, Bazaar Simulator Fans![/h3]

We’re excited to share some new features that make managing your market even easier and more enjoyable! As we move towards the full release, we're sharing these updates with you piece by piece to keep you in the loop.
[h2] Streamlined Management with Handcarts[/h2]
New handcarts  will  make transporting your goods easier and faster than ever. Effortlessly organize crates of products in your marketplace, saving precious time and making your business operations smoother and more efficient.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051738/67523b983b6155444dc5b2a1c7c0a8755401b81b.gif[/img]
[h2]Single Item Sales: Spice Up Your Offerings[/h2]
You will be able to sell individual items like cabbages, watermelons, and more. This feature will let you showcase your products one by one, giving customers a more personalized shopping experience. Diversify your strategies and keep your market fresh and engaging!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051738/f25b68ca0f7e7cf94b564c6011f515cb675b916f.gif[/img]

We’d love to hear your thoughts and suggestions! Your feedback is invaluable to us and helps shape the future of Bazaar Simulator.

[h3]See you in the next devlog![/h3]

Thank you,
The Bazaar Simulator Development Team
